types.description: Weidmüller HDC 24B DODQ 4BO — protective cover for the lower part (base) of a size 8 (24B/64D) heavy-duty connector housing

document.title: Weidmüller Data sheet HDC24B DODQ4BO
document.pages: 1 exact identity and cover version;2–3 mechanical data

modelingNotes: Exact manufacturer datasheet opened during coordinator review: size8 cover for lower housing, no cable entries, diecast aluminium with powder coating.
Mechanical accessory only; zero electrical terminals. Inserts and external housing bonding are separate.
IP65 is conditional on the plugged assembly; no standalone electrical or bonding rating is encoded.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical protective cover for a size 8 (24B/64D) HDC base housing; no electrical terminals. Installed environmental protection (IP65) is realized only in the closed/plugged condition and depends on the specified base housing, gasket and assembly.

COVER.connector: Protective cover for size 8 (24B/64D) HDC base housing, lower part
COVER.description: Mechanical attachment via side-locking clamp on the lower side; no electrical pins.
